title: Piece: Twinkle, Twinkle
summary: A tune everyone knows, across three strings.

steps.title: A French tune
text: This French melody from the 1700s is known around the world as **Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star**. Mozart wrote a famous set of variations on it.
It runs from the 5th string up to the 3rd.

steps.title: First line
text: Bars 1 to 4. The second half of each pair of bars ends on a half note.

steps.title: Middle
text: Bars 5 to 8: the same two bars, played twice.

steps.title: The whole tune
text: All twelve bars. The last four are the first four again. The page follows you.
